resources.string: Move your GPS with a joystick · up to 10 km/h

One-time setup:
1. Settings → About phone → tap “Build number” 7 times to enable Developer options.
2. Developer options → “Select mock location app” → JoyGPS.
3. For the floating joystick, allow “Display over other apps”.

Push the stick a little to stroll, all the way to the edge for 10 km/h. Up is north. Let go to stop.
